zh-CN.title: 灰原哀 · 冷静推理气泡重绘
items: 全新灰原哀半身立绘融入气泡边角，保留标志性的赤茶短发、眼神与白大褂
象牙白与暗梅色双向气泡，连续消息末尾展示角色，阅读更紧凑

en.title: Ai Haibara · Quiet Reasoning, redrawn
items: A new Ai Haibara portrait joins the bubble edge, with her auburn bob, cool gaze and lab coat
Ivory and plum bubbles place the portrait at the end of each message group for compact reading
